system.description:
INVESTED INVOCATION

Level 12; Price 11,000 gp; Usage any weapon; Activate Reaction; Trigger you inflict a critical hit; Frequency 1/day

This rune imbues the weapon with a harmonious aura.

When activated with a melodious note, the weapon resonates with the balance of the universe. You gain advantage on the attack critical roll.

On the sheet: Asked when you score a critical hit with the weapon, before the injury is rolled (a reaction, once a day): the critical injury is rolled twice and the worse result for the target kept; against a minor critical's disadvantage the two cancel (B9-3).
